fact: Since 18 May 2026 Imprensa Nacional de Cabo Verde personalises the national ID card, residence title and e-passport in Cabo Verde, with INCV, NOSI, IMIJ, DGRNI and Portugal's INCM teams having tuned the system together, and INCM retained under contract for blank supports and technical maintenance.
title: INCV passa a personalizar os documentos de identificação nacional
